verses.text: Of David. LORD, I call to you. My rock, do not refuse to hear me. If you stay silent, I will be like those who go down to the grave.
Hear my voice when I beg for mercy, when I cry to you for help, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who do evil. They speak friendly words to their neighbours, but they have evil in their hearts.
Pay them back for what they have done, for their evil actions. Pay them back for what their hands have done. Give them what they deserve.
They do not care about what the LORD has done or what his hands have made. So he will tear them down and never build them up again.
Praise the LORD, because he has heard my voice when I begged for mercy.
The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart jumps for joy, and I will thank him with my song.
The LORD is the strength of his people. He is a fortress that saves his anointed king.
Save your people and bless those who belong to you. Be their shepherd and carry them forever.
